118:t_019:12.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Watch this, $$サイデリアル$$! There are still tons of people on Earth who haven't given up!」

118:t_019:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We're going on the offensive! We decide this in one go!」

118:t_020:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The Empire's soldiers inside the base have also withdrawn from this area.」

118:t_020:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I suppose we've managed to get past the first hurdle...」

118:t_020:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「And while we were at it, we got to give that smug commander a taste of it, too.」

118:t_020:4.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「You were so cool, $$ノリエガ$$.」

118:t_020:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's the least I can do as a tactical forecaster.」

118:t_020:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Besides, it was only possible because of the forces $$カティ$$ sent our way.」

118:t_020:7.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Hey, they're praising us.」

118:t_020:9.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Be a little happy about it. Staying so wound up will just wear you out.」

118:t_020:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$エスター$$... We've managed to take back your hometown.)

118:t_021:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「D-Damn you! I will never forget this humiliation!」

118:t_021:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The next time we meet will be your last! Wait for that day in fear!」

118:t_022:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「A parting shot like that is pathetic.」

118:t_022:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Those half-baked types who think they're smart with no real skill to back it up are hopeless.」

118:t_022:3.en:
$n
「I feel it too. I'm sure that behind that guy there's...」

118:t_023:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed, multiple enemy units shot down...!」

118:t_023:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's what you get for underestimating the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon's firepower! We keep pushing and finish this in one go!」

118:t_100:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n, $$ジェニオン$$ is in top form! We can do this!」

118:t_100:1.en:
$n
(What is this feeling...? My heart and Miss $$スズネ$$'s are melting together, becoming one...)

118:t_100:2.en:
$n
(Is this what it means to become true partners...?)

118:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You must be the unit commander! By the book, I'll take you down first!」

118:t_101:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To think a man who can't even gauge our strength is their commander...!」

118:t_101:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You...! Are you making a fool of me!?」

118:t_101:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「After seeing a man who was both the Leader and a pilot at once, I can't help thinking that way!」

118:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Take this man down and the fight is decided!」

118:t_102:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Can a brat who mistakes recklessness for courage be a match for me!」

118:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You don't seem to know what happens on the battlefield to people who think they're better than their opponents!」

118:t_103:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I don't like it. A pure white machine doesn't belong on my battlefield.」

118:t_103:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Painting it red with your blood and the flames of your explosion might be amusing, too.」

118:t_103:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That pushiness...! It's unpleasant to listen to!」

118:t_103:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If a man like this is in command, there's an opening for us to exploit!」

118:t_104:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll swiftly take down the enemy commander and settle this!」

118:t_104:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Sound judgment. But there's one point on which you are decisively wrong.」

118:t_104:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Namely, that the likes of you cannot defeat my $$シャウラス$$.」

118:t_104:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「This guy...! Isn't he listening to me!」

118:t_105:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$! If I take him down, it will make a fine gift to bring back!」

118:t_105:1.en:
$n
「I didn't get the $$スフィア$$ just so you could take credit for it!」

118:t_105:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Then learn your place! Learn that a nobody like you is not permitted to possess a $$スフィア$$!」

118:t_105:3.en:
$n
「That's not for a stranger like you to say!」

118:t_105:5.en:
$n
「Many people gave me this power! Words from the likes of you won't shake me!」

118:t_106:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If it has come to this, I'll sink this ship with my own hands!」

118:t_106:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Brute force in the end, huh! He's simpler than I thought!」

118:t_106:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence! No, I will silence you myself!」

118:t_106:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If you think $$トレミー$$ is still just a transport with nothing but $$トランザム$$, you're badly mistaken.」

118:t_106:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Target, the enemy commander's unit! Commence attack!」

118:t_107:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Are you watching, boy...? I came here to fight beside you.)

118:t_107:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Ease up, Lightning. Strain yourself too hard and the Grim Reaper will latch onto you.」

118:t_107:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「As expected of Immortal $$コーラサワー$$. I appreciate the advice.」

118:t_107:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Anyway, once you're dead, it's over! Let's survive and fight to the very end!」

118:t_107:4.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Understood! $$グラハム・エーカー$$, going in!」
